name: golazo
description: GOLAZO — bet the play. Live, in-the-moment parimutuel betting on discrete game events.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @golazo/core && npm run test --workspace @golazo/feed

comment:dependencies: expo-router is pinned at the workspace root ONLY so it hoists next to the root-hoisted babel-preset-expo. babel-preset-expo gates its expo-router Babel transform on require.resolve('expo-router') from its own (root) location; with expo-router nested in apps/mobile/node_modules that resolve fails and the EXPO_ROUTER_APP_ROOT inlining is skipped, crashing the _ctx require.context transform. Keep in sync with apps/mobile.
